title: Super CosmoJet
description:
Super CosmoJet is a 2D physics-based action space game. Master gravity and your ship's thrust controls to navigate hazardous star systems, on your quest to find your missing father. Each star system is procedurally generated at runtime, so no two play-throughs are the same!MAKE YOUR WAY
In today's galaxy, you'll need to earn credits to travel! Transport passengers, deliver cargo with your tractor beam, mine asteroids for gold or destroy enemies for bounty payments. Spend your hard-earned cash on ship upgrades and weapons, and save up enough to buy your way to the next system through hyperspace jump gates.UNLOCK NEW SHIPS
Complete your quest to unlock new ship types. Each handles differently, and mastering each of them will provide a lasting challenge.BUY UPGRADES
Each unlockable ship has it's own strengths and weaknesses, and these can be enhanced by purchasing new weapons and upgrades. Strengthen your hull, make your boost more powerful, buy rockets, torpedoes or beam lasers... The list goes on!FEATURES
• Master flying three different unlockable ships, with different handling and weapons 

• Physics-based gameplay: Land on planets with different gravitational fields, and avoid black holes and other environmental hazards like asteroids

• Procedural generation ensures a different experience every time

• Steam Achievements

• Mouse/keyboard and controller support
